title: Faithfully flat local stalk maps reflect surjectivity
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a flat local homomorphism of local rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then $A\to B$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. Consequently, if $M\to N$ is a homomorphism of $A$-modules [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] and $M\otimes_A B\to N\otimes_A B$ is surjective, then $M\to N$ is surjective.
